title: MIT Just Scored a Perfect 100 — 15 Years at #1 (QS 2027)
description:
MIT tops the QS World University Rankings 2027 for the 15th year in a row — this time with a perfect overall score of 100. Imperial College London and Stanford tie for #2, Oxford is #4, and Harvard is #5. The 2027 edition, released 18 June 2026, ranks 1,500+ universities across 106 education systems.

Which school finally breaks the streak? Subscribe for more on how the world's top colleges stack up.

Sources:
